description: A registered user who forgot their password can reset it via an email link.
testSteps:
1. Navigate to /forgot-password
2. Enter a valid registered email address
3. Click the 'Send reset link' button
4. Verify success message 'Check your inbox' is displayed
5. Navigate to reset password page with a stubbed token
6. Enter a new password that meets requirements
7. Confirm the new password
8. Click 'Reset password'
9. Verify redirect to /login
10. Verify login works with the new password
componentDescription: PasswordResetForm React component with: email input, new-password input, confirm-password input, submit button, success/error message area. Located at src/components/auth/PasswordResetForm.tsx
